<div class="interactive-lab notebook-lab" data-notebook-lab>
<noscript><p>Enable JavaScript for browser practice, or <a href="downloads/motion-perception.zip">download the project</a> to run the notebooks in Jupyter.</p></noscript>

<nav class="lab-missions" aria-label="Notebook exercises">
<button type="button" id="state" data-scenario="state"><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">1</span> Run notebook cells</button>
<button type="button" id="refactor" data-scenario="refactor"><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">2</span> Extract a Python function</button>
<button type="button" id="config" data-scenario="config"><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">3</span> Change a setting</button>
<button type="button" id="handoff" data-scenario="handoff"><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">4</span> Reproduce a figure</button>
</nav>

<div class="lab-layout">
<section class="mission-card" aria-labelledby="notebook-mission-title">
<p class="exercise-progress" data-exercise-progress></p>
<h2 id="notebook-mission-title" data-lab-title tabindex="-1">Run notebook cells</h2>
<p data-lab-goal></p>

<div id="current-step" class="notebook-step" tabindex="-1">
<p class="exercise-progress" data-step-progress></p>
<p class="step-instruction" data-step-instruction aria-live="polite"></p>
<div data-step-prediction hidden>
<label for="notebook-prediction">Your prediction (optional)</label>
<textarea id="notebook-prediction" data-prediction rows="2"></textarea>
</div>
<div class="mission-actions">
<button type="button" class="primary-action" data-guide-action disabled></button>
<a class="button-primary" href="git-playground.html?mission=staging" data-continue-git hidden>Continue to Git practice <span data-icon="arrow"></span></a>
<button type="button" class="text-action" data-view-output hidden></button>
</div>
<div class="kernel-line">
<span class="status-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<p role="status" data-kernel-status>Python starts when you run code.</p>
<button type="button" class="stop-action" data-stop-python hidden>Stop</button>
</div>
<p class="guide-feedback" data-guide-feedback role="status"></p>
<details class="error-details" data-error-details hidden><summary>Python error details</summary><pre data-error-trace></pre></details>
</div>

<details data-mission-instructions><summary>All steps</summary><ol data-lab-steps></ol></details>
<details data-hint-panel><summary>Show hint</summary><p data-lab-hint></p></details>
<details data-solution-panel><summary>Worked solution</summary><p data-lab-explanation></p><button type="button" data-solution>Load worked solution</button></details>
</section>

<section class="notebook-workspace" aria-label="Python workspace">
<header class="workspace-heading">
<div><span class="workspace-icon" data-icon="notebook"></span><strong>motion-perception</strong></div>
<details class="workspace-options"><summary>Notebook tools</summary>
<div class="lab-controls">
<button type="button" data-run-all="current">Run all cells</button>
<button type="button" data-run-all="fresh">Restart &amp; run all</button>
<button type="button" data-inspect>Execution history</button>
<button type="button" data-reset-lesson>Reset exercise</button>
</div>
</details>
</header>

<div class="lab-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Workspace files" data-workspace-tabs>
<button type="button" id="tab-notebook" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="pane-notebook" data-pane="notebook"><span data-icon="notebook"></span> analysis.ipynb</button>
<button type="button" id="tab-helper" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="pane-helper" data-pane="helper" tabindex="-1"><span class="file-type">py</span> helpers.py</button>
<button type="button" id="tab-config" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="pane-config" data-pane="config" tabindex="-1"><span data-icon="sliders"></span> analysis.toml</button>
<button type="button" id="tab-inspect" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="pane-inspect" data-pane="inspect" tabindex="-1"><span data-icon="search"></span> Inspect</button>
</div>
<div id="pane-notebook" class="workspace-pane" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-notebook" data-pane-content="notebook">
<div class="editor-caption"><span data-icon="code"></span> Cells share the same Python session<span><kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd> to run a cell</span></div>
<div data-cells></div>
</div>
<div id="pane-helper" class="workspace-pane file-pane" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-helper" data-pane-content="helper" hidden>
<div class="file-heading"><label for="helper-editor">helpers.py</label><button type="button" data-save-file="helper">Save helpers.py</button></div>
<p class="file-guidance">Save the file, then rerun the import cell and any cells that call the function.</p>
<textarea id="helper-editor" class="code-editor" data-helper rows="8" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
</div>
<div id="pane-config" class="workspace-pane file-pane" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-config" data-pane-content="config" hidden>
<div class="file-heading"><label for="config-editor">config/analysis.toml</label><button type="button" data-save-file="config">Save analysis.toml</button></div>
<p class="file-guidance">Save the settings, then rerun the notebook so it reads them.</p>
<textarea id="config-editor" class="code-editor" data-config rows="9" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
</div>
<div id="pane-inspect" class="workspace-pane" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-inspect" data-pane-content="inspect" hidden>
<div class="inspector-grid"><section><h3>Live variables</h3><p>The names currently held by this Python session.</p><pre data-variables>No live variables.</pre></section><section><h3>Execution history</h3><p>The order in which cells ran in this session.</p><pre data-execution-log>No cells run yet.</pre></section></div>
</div>

<footer class="workspace-bottom">
<a class="back-to-step" href="#current-step">Back to current step</a>
<details class="download-menu"><summary><span data-icon="download"></span> Export work</summary><div class="lab-controls"><button type="button" data-download="notebook">Download .ipynb</button><button type="button" data-download="helper">Download helpers.py</button><button type="button" data-download="config">Download analysis.toml</button></div></details>
</footer>
</section>
</div>

<p class="small-note lab-footnote">Drafts are saved in this browser when storage is available. Python starts with empty variables each visit. The first run loads about 32 MB.</p>
<details class="notebook-reference">
<summary>Run the project in Jupyter</summary>
<p><a href="downloads/motion-perception.zip">Download the complete project</a> and follow <a href="setup.html">local setup</a> to run the three example notebooks. To run an exported exercise notebook, use the project root as the working directory. Put the exported <code>helpers.py</code> in the project root and <code>analysis.toml</code> in <code>config/</code>.</p>
<p>The browser runs Python 3.12.7, NumPy 2.0.2, pandas 2.2.3, and Matplotlib 3.8.4. The downloaded project has its own dependency lock. Browser cells support ordinary Python with the bundled packages. A cell has a 15-second execution limit.</p>
</details>
</div>
